description: This file defines the class ClaimExpenseSearchFilterParams in the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base filter parameters class and adds a requestId property with getter and setter methods, used for filtering claim expense search results.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class extending FilterParams, used for specifying search criteria for claim expense filtering, including a request ID.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with this filter parameters object.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for this filter parameters object.
